_about: Voice conversation evaluation (2026-10-21/22): 7 test scripts, 23 user lines spoken by macOS voices at speaking pace (scripts/speech_eval/run_front_llm.py, run_qwen3_omni.py, run_open_voice.py, run_minicpmo.py, run_gpt_realtime.py, run_gpt_live.py, run_gemini_live.py). start_s: end of the user's speech to the assistant's first sound (median); answer_s: to the spoken lookup result; decisions: ask back / look up / answer right (systems with tools only); traditional: share of Chinese replies in Traditional characters; grounded: replies without made-up facts (AI judge, Azure gpt-5.4); natural: 1-5 (AI judge). null = not measured or not applicable.

systems.name: 地端串接語音對話（串流辨識 → Gemma 4 12B → 語音合成）
systems.name_en: Local cascaded voice chat (streaming ASR → Gemma 4 12B → TTS)
systems.note: 要查資料的語音助理首選；插話 0.2 秒內停下
systems.note_en: First choice when lookups are needed; stops within 0.2 s of a barge-in

systems.name: Qwen3-Omni 30B-A3B
systems.note: 不用查資料的閒聊首選；20 GB
systems.note_en: Best for small talk without lookups; 20 GB

systems.name: MiniCPM-o 4.5
systems.note: 快、最小（8.6 GB），但多用簡體
systems.note_en: Fast and smallest (8.6 GB), mostly Simplified

systems.name: MiMo-Audio 7B
systems.note: 要整段生完才能播；會編造、簡繁混用
systems.note_en: Plays only once fully generated; makes things up, mixes scripts

systems.name: MiniCPM-o 4.5 全雙工
systems.note: 會邊聽邊附和，但 23 句有 10 句沒回應、多為簡體
systems.note_en: Back-channels while listening, but 10 of 23 lines got no reply; mostly Simplified

systems.name: Azure gpt-realtime
systems.note: 雲端最快、自己呼叫工具；錄音要上傳
systems.note_en: Fastest in the cloud, calls the tools itself; audio is uploaded

systems.name: Azure gpt-live-1
systems.note: 單句最像真人；長對話越來越慢、會斷線
systems.note_en: Most human-like turn by turn; slows down and drops in long sessions

systems.name: Google gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio
systems.note: 只用腳本測過，平台未接
systems.note_en: Tested by script only, not in the platform

systems.name: AWS Nova 2 Sonic
systems.note: 官方沒列中文但聽得懂；中文多寫簡體、英文問題常用中文回答，被插話幾乎不停（5.8 秒）
systems.note_en: Not officially Chinese but understands it; mostly Simplified, often answers English in Chinese, barely stops when interrupted (5.8 s)

systems.name: Google gemini-3.8-live
systems.note: 常聽錯地名（台中→海口）；只用腳本測過
systems.note_en: Often mishears place names; tested by script only
